title: Has potential but not worth the money
text:
I wanted to like this box since I haven't seen anything like it so far. The quality of the products seem discount store like.

I love that a robe and fluffy socks were inside but it seems like the type of material to shed on everything if you wash it with other clothes.

It also came with 2 lip glosses without safety seals. The bubble bath and bath salts were nice. Winter berry with a pleasant scent.

I was surprised and excited it also came with perfume. The consistency was an spray oil which threw me off and smelled like overly sweet floral mistletoe.

I also received 2 face masks and a super thin sleeping eye mask. Unfortunately, I don't think the quality is worth the price.
label: neutral
